mentions.name: asset-helper
mentions.description: A Mac app that mirrors the Windows-only "Kenney Assets Launcher", combining game asset tools into one. Built as a way to teach the author Swift.
mentions.problem: The Kenney Assets Launcher is Windows only, so there is no equivalent for Mac.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Teaching myself Swift, by building a Mac app that mirrors the "Kenney Assets Launcher" (which is Windows only): https://github.com/matula/asset-helper

Basically combining some game asset tools into one.
